links.outcome: GPT-4 hallucinations and inferred recommendations in generated text
links.effect: No findings hallucinated outright; 2.8% of cases included generated text about recommendations inferred without specific reference.
links.quote: No findings were "hallucinated" outright. However, 2.8% of cases included generated text about recommendations that were inferred without specific reference.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt optimization on a validation set before testing on unseen reports

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 on retrospective radiology reports to detect incidental findings and generate patient-facing instructions; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
